question: What is the meaning of the word 'Taraf' under the Bahmani Sultanate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Province**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Under the Bahmani Sultanate, the word **'Taraf' means 'Province'**.
 
• The Bahmani Sultanate was a medieval Indian kingdom located in the Deccan region.
 
• It was established in **1347 **by **Ala-ud-Din Bahman Shah**.
 
• The Sultanate was divided into several provinces known as '**Tarafs**', each governed by a '**Tarafdar**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Bahmani Sultanate played a significant role in the history of the Deccan region and laid the foundation for the Deccan Sultanates.
 
• It is known for its contributions to art, architecture, and culture in the region.
 
• The capital of the** Bahmani Sultanate** was initially at **Gulbarga **and later moved to **Bidar**.
